answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 342 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the relic challenge, the ember audit can replay the summit history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1081 identities would post 4302 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
